result.title: CaT-Movie: Balancing Global Planning and Local Rendering for Long Multi-Shot Video Generation
result.summary: Current multi-shot video generators render only limited durations per pass, requiring long movies to be stitched from local segments across which narrative progression and visual identity drift. To synthesize long-horizon movies with Coherence across Time, we present CaT-Movie, a multi-shot generation system consisting of a global story planner and a local window renderer. The planner expands user requests via a large language model to preserve, infer, and complete story details, while deterministic code maintains the resulting storyboard across shots to compile self-contained shot prompts and index reference frames from generated history. To execute this guidance, the renderer applies reference-routed sparse self-attention and shot-wise cross-attention to route identities from the indexed frames while isolating per-shot textual conditions. Given the scarcity of high-quality open-source multi-shot data, we construct a dataset of over 350K film shots annotated with semantic state transitions, entity grounding, and multi-granularity requests. We further build CaT-MBench, a benchmark on held-out films with the same annotations. It gives every baseline its native format and counts cross-shot consistency only when a cut opens a new camera setup, preventing repeated framing from passing as consistency. On CaT-MBench, CaT-Movie attains the highest average score and the most consistent characters among all methods. The project page is available at https://jinplu.github.io/CaT-Movie/.

AI.brief_summary: 提出 CaT-Movie 长时段多镜头视频生成系统，由 LLM 全局故事规划器与局部窗口渲染器组成，并用确定性代码在镜头之间维护故事板、生成镜头提示并索引参考帧，另构建带语义状态转移标注的数据集与评测基准。
AI.relevance_reason: 其显式持久的故事板状态与「语义状态转移」标注，可能与长程推理中的外部状态维护、身份信息漂移与表示坍缩问题形成类比，可供核查；但任务属视频生成，迁移到 VLM latent 推理仍属推测。
